name: Media viewer
description: Shows the duration, codecs, tracks and tags of audio and video files, their cover, and the EXIF of TIFF, raw and HEIC photos.

codes.01a1b720-fdcc-7b78-bca0-da328630ad19.bad: The audio file is damaged, or its contents are not the format its extension names.
The photo's EXIF data is damaged.
The video file is damaged: a part of it is cut off or larger than the file.
codes.01a1b720-fdcc-7b78-bca0-da328630ad19.no_: No EXIF data was found in the first 8 MiB of the photo.
The video file has no movie header (moov); it may be incomplete.
codes.01a1b720-fdcc-7b78-bca0-da328630ad19.not: The file is not an audio file, video file or photo the media viewer reads.
codes.01a1b720-fdcc-7b78-bca0-da328630ad19.too: A part of the file the viewer must read (a tag, the cover or the movie header) is larger than it reads.
